title: AITA for leaving my family's Thanksgiving?
question: AITA for leaving my family's Thanksgiving?
body:
So my parents. 2 brothers and 2 uncles decided to go out to eat at a localish buffet for Thanksgiving. Only my parents really wanted to go, everyone else was against it but went along with it because we normally do Thanksgiving at my parents house. We got to the buffet, it was an hour away, and the place had an hour wait. My parents decided that a 15 minute wait was long enough and decided everyone would go to the Whataburger next door. Niether me not my youngest brother wanted to eat, so we didnt order anything my mother got really offended and basically yelled at us in the restuarant. My dad told us that "since whataburger wasnt good enough. We can just leave" so we did.

My brother who stayed called me and told me my parents are upset and that they think we ruined Thanksgiving for everyone.

Tl;dr AITA for listening to my Dad and leaving Thanksgiving?
